output_evals.prompt: Które sektory na GPW są mocne, a które słabe?
assertions: scripts/gpw_sector_trend.py was executed
Answer in Polish lists top and bottom sectors by uptrend ratio with direction
Answer describes cyclical vs defensive rotation
Small-sample sectors are flagged as less reliable
No company-level buy/sell recommendation

output_evals.prompt: Are Polish banks still trending up?
assertions: Answer in English quotes WIG-BANKI uptrend ratio, direction and 20-session index change vs WIG
Answer states the data date

output_evals.prompt: Czy są jakieś ostrzeżenia w trendach sektorowych?
assertions: Answer lists every warning present in composite.warnings, or says there are none

output_evals.prompt: Pokaż wykres rotacji sektorów (RRG) na GPW.
assertions: scripts/gpw_sector_trend.py was executed with --rrg
Answer in Polish names the items in each quadrant (liderzy, słabnące, maruderzy, poprawa) as in rrg.items
Answer quotes the rotation summary (recent quadrant transitions) or says there were none
Answer explains the axes and the usual clockwise rotation in plain words and states at least one limitation
Concentrated sector indices (e.g. WIG-ODZIEZ ~ LPP) are flagged as dominated by 1-2 companies
Answer says RS-Ratio/RS-Momentum are an approximation of the proprietary JdK indicators
Answer states the data date (rrg.as_of) and mentions a partial week if rrg.partial_week is true
No buy/sell recommendation

output_evals.prompt: Which Polish sector is moving into the leading quadrant?
assertions: scripts/gpw_sector_trend.py was executed with --rrg and --lang en
Answer lists the improving -> leading transitions from rrg.rotation_summary, or items approaching leading, or says none
Answer gives RS-Ratio and RS-Momentum for each named sector exactly as in the JSON

output_evals.prompt: Które banki są najsilniejsze na tle WIG-BANKI? Pokaż RRG.
assertions: scripts/gpw_sector_trend.py was executed with --rrg --stocks for the banks sector
Answer compares bank stocks against WIG-BANKI (the benchmark in rrg.benchmark), not against WIG
Illiquid or too-short-history names listed in rrg.excluded are mentioned as excluded
